body.t: Paste an ordered polygon outline to calculate its area centroid in a local equirectangular projection. This is the centre of the shape under that planar approximation, not the average of its vertices and not the location that minimizes driving time. Record the input and mode with any exported or reported result.

A small rectangle with latitude/longitude corners 0,0; 0,0.01; 0.01,0.01; 0.01,0 has its symmetric centroid near 0.005,0.005. A concave polygon can have a centroid outside the polygon; that is not necessarily a calculation error.
